lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns across the lateral flank. Individual blobs within these columns exhibit a staggered spatial distribution, with 3-5 primary nodes per vertical line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal carinae and the primary blob clusters, forming a rough grid-like pattern across the visible flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient (light on the upper edge, shadow on the lower edge) running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A clear transition in spot morphology is observed from the anterior region, where spots are small and densely packed, to the posterior region, where they become larger and more isolated.
